title: Growing Oyster Mushrooms on Rice Straw
description: Learn how to cultivate oyster mushrooms using rice straw as substrate
steps: Collect fresh rice straw and chop into 2-3 inch pieces
Soak straw in water for 24 hours to soften
Steam sterilize the straw for 1 hour to kill harmful microorganisms
Cool the straw to room temperature
Inoculate with oyster mushroom spawn at 2-3% rate
Pack in plastic bags with air holes
Maintain 80-85% humidity and 25-28°C temperature
Harvest mushrooms after 10-15 days

title: Making Compost from Rice Straw
description: Convert rice straw into nutrient-rich compost for your crops
steps: Chop rice straw into small pieces (1-2 inches)
Create layers: straw, green materials (kitchen waste), soil
Maintain 3:1 ratio of brown (straw) to green materials
Add water to maintain 50-60% moisture
Turn the pile every 2 weeks
Monitor temperature (should reach 140-160°F)
Compost is ready in 3-4 months when dark and crumbly

title: Making Handicrafts from Corn Husks
description: Create valuable handicrafts and decorative items from corn husks
steps: Collect fresh corn husks and remove silk
Soak husks in warm water for 30 minutes to make pliable
Flatten and dry husks partially (still flexible)
Cut husks into desired shapes and sizes
Weave or braid husks into baskets, mats, or dolls
Allow to dry completely
Apply natural varnish for durability

title: Using Wheat Straw as Garden Mulch
description: Apply wheat straw mulch to improve soil health and crop yields
steps: Ensure wheat straw is dry and free from seeds
Clear weeds from the area to be mulched
Apply 2-4 inch layer of straw around plants
Keep mulch 2 inches away from plant stems
Water lightly to settle the mulch
Replenish mulch as it decomposes
Turn under soil at end of season

title: Making Paper from Sugarcane Bagasse
description: Create handmade paper using sugarcane bagasse fiber
steps: Clean bagasse and remove any remaining sugar
Boil bagasse in water with sodium hydroxide for 2 hours
Wash thoroughly to remove chemicals
Beat the pulp to break down fibers
Mix pulp with water in large container
Use screen to lift thin layer of pulp from water
Press and dry the paper sheets
Trim edges for finished paper
